articles.title: Bitcoin treasury space still has fair share of ‘carnival barkers’: BSTR founder

articles.title: Fidelity Digital Assets highlights 'growing evidence' of shift from dollar-based systems

articles.title: Florida Candidate Liquidates $800K in Bitcoin to Bankroll Congressional Bid

articles.title: AI Chatbots Could Quietly Pull Users Away From Reality, Researchers Warn
articles.snippet: Researchers warn that prolonged chatbot interactions could distort how some users experience reality and social connection.
